audit.note: each StepInput change toasts `Value changed to '{0}'` roundtrip-free via control_global MESSAGE_TOAST.show ({0} filled by ${$parameters>/value}); the single quotes rely on get_t_arg's ' -> \' escaping (abap2UI5 branch); the app is now init-only

deviations.what: the sample binds a List to the JSON model /modelData and renders one templated CustomListItem per row. **Rebuilt as that ONE bound template on 2026-08-05** (it used to be 14 unrolled static items): the rows are bound with client->_bind( val = modeldata omit_initial_paths = ... ), the parameter added upstream for exactly this shape (pr/model-empty-vs-default), so a property a row does not set stays ABSENT from the model and the StepInput keeps its own default instead of receiving ``. The dropped template property valueState is back as well. The omission is SCOPED to the numeric/string columns because the two BOOLEAN properties must send their explicit false (abap_false is itself initial, so the blanket flag would have dropped it and the disabled / read-only row would render enabled) - which is why the port binds enabled/editable as plain {ENABLED}/{EDITABLE} again, with no expression binding and no binding-value deviation left. Rows the sample leaves untouched send the control default true explicitly.

the change toast was switched to a roundtrip-free client-composed toast on 2026-07-22 (control_global MESSAGE_TOAST.show, template `Value changed to '{0}'` with get_t_arg single-quote escaping; on_event dropped, init-only) - re-verify changing a StepInput toasts "Value changed to '<value>'" with the quotes intact. **e2e-verified 2026-07-30** (transpiled-framework interaction, scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs): ArrowUp + Enter on the first StepInput fires change and toasts "Value changed to '<value>'" with the quotes intact; the other StepInputs are the identical wire.

render_smoke.reason:
The rebuilt bound template binds the numeric StepInput properties min/max/step/value, and - like the ORIGINAL sample's aData - most rows do not set them (that is the point of the omit_initial rebuild). UI5 logs 'The value of property

must be a number' for such a row, so the render harness sees a console error that the running original produces just as well: the sample's own template binds min='{min}' over rows without a min. Nothing in the port is wrong, and seeding the numbers back would restore exactly the workaround this rebuild removed. Re-check when the render gate learns to treat an absent numeric path as the control default.
